blocks.en_text: What if I told you there was something that you can do right now
blocks.zh_text: 如果我告诉你，有件事你现在就能做

blocks.en_text: that would have an immediate, positive benefit for your brain
blocks.zh_text: 它能立刻给你的大脑带来积极的益处

blocks.en_text: including your mood and your focus?
blocks.zh_text: 包括你的情绪和专注力，你信吗？

blocks.en_text: And what if I told you that same thing could actually last a long time
blocks.zh_text: 如果我告诉你，同样这件事还能持续很久

blocks.en_text: and protect your brain from different conditions
blocks.zh_text: 并且保护你的大脑免受各种疾病的侵袭

blocks.en_text: like depression, Alzheimer's disease or dementia.
blocks.zh_text: 比如抑郁症、阿尔茨海默病或痴呆症。

blocks.en_text: Would you do it?
blocks.zh_text: 你会去做吗？

blocks.en_text: Yes!
blocks.zh_text: 会！

blocks.en_text: I am talking about the powerful effects of physical activity.
blocks.zh_text: 我说的就是身体活动的强大功效。

blocks.en_text: Simply moving your body,
blocks.zh_text: 仅仅是活动你的身体，

blocks.en_text: has immediate, long-lasting and protective benefits for your brain.
blocks.zh_text: 就能给你的大脑带来即时的、持久的和保护性的益处。

blocks.en_text: And that can last for the rest of your life.
blocks.zh_text: 而且这种益处能伴随你的余生。

blocks.en_text: So what I want to do today is tell you a story
blocks.zh_text: 所以今天我想给你们讲一个故事

blocks.en_text: about how I used my deep understanding of neuroscience,
blocks.zh_text: 讲我如何运用自己对神经科学的深刻理解，

blocks.en_text: as a professor of neuroscience,
blocks.zh_text: 作为一名神经科学教授，

blocks.en_text: to essentially do an experiment on myself
blocks.zh_text: 基本上就是在我自己身上做了个实验

blocks.en_text: in which I discovered the science underlying
blocks.zh_text: 在实验中，我发现了背后的科学原理

blocks.en_text: why exercise is the most transformative thing
blocks.zh_text: 解释了为什么运动是最能改变你大脑的事情

blocks.en_text: that you can do for your brain today.
blocks.zh_text: 是你今天就能为大脑做的事。

blocks.en_text: Now, as a neuroscientist, I know that our brains,
blocks.zh_text: 作为一名神经科学家，我知道我们的大脑，

blocks.en_text: that is the thing in our head right now,
blocks.zh_text: 也就是此刻我们脑袋里的这个东西，

blocks.en_text: that is the most complex structure known to humankind.
blocks.zh_text: 是已知人类所知最复杂的结构。

blocks.en_text: But it's one thing to talk about the brain,
blocks.zh_text: 但谈论大脑是一回事，

blocks.en_text: and it's another to see it.
blocks.zh_text: 亲眼看到它又是另一回事。

blocks.en_text: So here is a real preserved human brain.
blocks.zh_text: 这里有一个真实的、保存下来的人脑。

blocks.en_text: And it's going to illustrate two key areas that we are going to talk about today.
blocks.zh_text: 它将展示我们今天要讲的两个关键区域。

blocks.en_text: The first is the prefrontal cortex, right behind your forehead,
blocks.zh_text: 第一个是前额叶皮层，就在你额头正后方，

blocks.en_text: critical for things like decision-making, focus, attention and your personality.
blocks.zh_text: 对决策、专注、注意力和你的性格等至关重要。

blocks.en_text: The second key area is located in the temporal lobe, shown right here.
blocks.zh_text: 第二个关键区域位于颞叶，就在这里。

blocks.en_text: You have two temporal lobes in your brain, the right and the left,
blocks.zh_text: 你的大脑有两个颞叶，一个在右，一个在左，

blocks.en_text: and deep in the temporal lobe is a key structure
blocks.zh_text: 而在颞叶深处有一个关键结构

blocks.en_text: critical for your ability
blocks.zh_text: 它对你的能力至关重要

blocks.en_text: to form and retain new long-term memories for facts and events.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是形成并保留关于事实和事件的新长期记忆的能力。

blocks.en_text: And that structure is called the hippocampus.
blocks.zh_text: 这个结构叫做海马体。

blocks.en_text: So I've always been fascinated with the hippocampus.
blocks.zh_text: 我一直对海马体着迷。

blocks.en_text: How could it be that an event that lasts just a moment,
blocks.zh_text: 一个只持续片刻的事件，怎么会

blocks.en_text: say, your first kiss,
blocks.zh_text: 比如说，你的初吻，

blocks.en_text: or the moment your first child was born,
blocks.zh_text: 或者你第一个孩子出生的那一刻，

blocks.en_text: can form a memory that has changed your brain,
blocks.zh_text: 能形成一段改变了你大脑的记忆，

blocks.en_text: that lasts an entire lifetime?
blocks.zh_text: 并且持续整整一生呢？

blocks.en_text: That's what I want to understand.
blocks.zh_text: 这就是我想弄明白的。

blocks.en_text: I wanted to start and record the activity of individual brain cells
blocks.zh_text: 我想开始记录单个脑细胞的活动

blocks.en_text: in the hippocampus
blocks.zh_text: 在海马体中

blocks.en_text: as subjects were forming new memories.
blocks.zh_text: 在受试者形成新记忆的时候。

blocks.en_text: And essentially try and decode how those brief bursts of electrical activity,
blocks.zh_text: 并且基本上试着去破解那些短暂的电活动爆发是如何

blocks.en_text: which is how neurons communicate with each other,
blocks.zh_text: 也就是神经元之间相互交流的方式，

blocks.en_text: how those brief bursts either allowed us to form a new memory, or did not.
blocks.zh_text: 那些短暂的爆发活动是如何让我们形成新记忆，或者没能形成记忆的。

blocks.en_text: But a few years ago, I did something very unusual in science.
blocks.zh_text: 但几年前，我做了一件在科学界很不寻常的事。

blocks.en_text: As a full professor of neural science,
blocks.zh_text: 作为一名神经科学正教授，

blocks.en_text: I decided to completely switch my research program.
blocks.zh_text: 我决定彻底转换我的研究方向。

blocks.en_text: Because I encountered something that was so amazing,
blocks.zh_text: 因为我遇到了一个太令人惊叹的东西，

blocks.en_text: with the potential to change so many lives
blocks.zh_text: 它有潜力改变许多人的生活

blocks.en_text: that I had to study it.
blocks.zh_text: 以至于我必须去研究它。

blocks.en_text: I discovered and I experienced the brain-changing effects of exercise.
blocks.zh_text: 我发现并亲身体验了运动改变大脑的效果。

blocks.en_text: And I did it in a completely inadvertent way.
blocks.zh_text: 而且我完全是无意中做到的。

blocks.en_text: I was actually at the height of all the memory work that I was doing --
blocks.zh_text: 当时我其实正处于我所有记忆研究的巅峰——

blocks.en_text: data was pouring in,
blocks.zh_text: 数据源源不断地涌来，

blocks.en_text: I was becoming known in my field for all of this memory work.
blocks.zh_text: 我因为这些记忆研究在领域内渐渐有了名气。

blocks.en_text: And it should have been going great. It was, scientifically.
blocks.zh_text: 按理说一切应该都很顺利。从科学角度讲，确实如此。

blocks.en_text: But when I stuck my head out of my lab door,
blocks.zh_text: 但当我从实验室门口探出头来，

blocks.en_text: I noticed something.
blocks.zh_text: 我注意到了一件事。

blocks.en_text: I had no social life.
blocks.zh_text: 我完全没有社交生活。

blocks.en_text: I spent too much time listening to those brain cells
blocks.zh_text: 我花了太多时间听那些脑细胞说话，

blocks.en_text: in a dark room, by myself.
blocks.zh_text: 一个人待在黑屋子里。

blocks.en_text: I didn't move my body at all.
blocks.zh_text: 我完全不活动身体。

blocks.en_text: I had gained 25 pounds.
blocks.zh_text: 我胖了25磅。

blocks.en_text: And actually, it took me many years to realize it,
blocks.zh_text: 而且实际上，我花了好多年才意识到，

blocks.en_text: I was actually miserable.
blocks.zh_text: 我其实过得很痛苦。

blocks.en_text: And I shouldn't be miserable.
blocks.zh_text: 我不该过得这么痛苦。

blocks.en_text: And I went on a river-rafting trip -- by myself, because I had no social life.
blocks.zh_text: 后来我去参加了一次漂流旅行——一个人去的，因为我没社交生活。

blocks.en_text: And I came back --
blocks.zh_text: 回来后——

blocks.en_text: thinking, "Oh, my God, I was the weakest person on that trip."
blocks.zh_text: 我心里想：“天哪，我是那次旅行中最弱的人。”

blocks.en_text: And I came back with a mission.
blocks.zh_text: 我回来后带着一个使命。

blocks.en_text: I said, "I'm never going to feel like the weakest person
blocks.zh_text: 我说：“我再也不会让自己感觉是最弱的那个人，

blocks.en_text: on a river-rafting trip again."
blocks.zh_text: 在漂流旅行中再也不会了。”

blocks.en_text: And that's what made me go to the gym.
blocks.zh_text: 正是这让我走进了健身房。

blocks.en_text: And I focused my type-A personality
blocks.zh_text: 我把我那种A型人格的劲头

blocks.en_text: on going to all the exercise classes at the gym.
blocks.zh_text: 全用在去健身房上各种健身课上了。

blocks.en_text: I tried everything.
blocks.zh_text: 我什么都试了。

blocks.en_text: I went to kickbox, dance, yoga, step class,
blocks.zh_text: 我去了搏击课、舞蹈课、瑜伽课、踏板课，

blocks.en_text: and at first it was really hard.
blocks.zh_text: 一开始真的很难。

blocks.en_text: But what I noticed is that after every sweat-inducing workout that I tried,
blocks.zh_text: 但我注意到，每次我尝试的让人出汗的锻炼之后，

blocks.en_text: I had this great mood boost and this great energy boost.
blocks.zh_text: 我的心情都会大大提升，精力也会大大提升。

blocks.en_text: And that's what kept me going back to the gym.
blocks.zh_text: 正是这让我一次次回到健身房。

blocks.en_text: Well, I started feeling stronger.
blocks.zh_text: 后来，我开始感觉更强壮了。

blocks.en_text: I started feeling better, I even lost that 25 pounds.
blocks.zh_text: 我开始感觉更好了，我甚至减掉了那25磅。

blocks.en_text: And now, fast-forward a year and a half into this regular exercise program
blocks.zh_text: 现在，快进到这个规律锻炼计划进行了一年半之后

blocks.en_text: and I noticed something that really made me sit up and take notice.
blocks.zh_text: 我注意到了一些让我真正坐直了、认真关注的事情。

blocks.en_text: I was sitting at my desk, writing a research grant,
blocks.zh_text: 我当时坐在书桌前，写着一份科研经费申请，

blocks.en_text: and a thought went through my mind
blocks.zh_text: 然后一个念头闪过我的脑海，

blocks.en_text: that had never gone through my mind before.
blocks.zh_text: 这个念头以前从来没有在我脑海里出现过。

blocks.en_text: And that thought was,
blocks.zh_text: 那个念头就是，

blocks.en_text: "Gee, grant-writing is going well today."
blocks.zh_text: “哎呀，今天经费申请写得挺顺利啊。”

blocks.en_text: And all the scientists --
blocks.zh_text: 然后所有科学家——

blocks.en_text: yeah, all the scientists always laugh when I say that,
blocks.zh_text: 对，所有科学家听我这么说都会笑，

blocks.en_text: because grant-writing never goes well.
blocks.zh_text: 因为经费申请从来就没顺利过。

blocks.en_text: It is so hard; you're always pulling your hair out,
blocks.zh_text: 它太难了，你总是抓耳挠腮、焦头烂额，

blocks.en_text: trying to come up with that million-dollar-winning idea.
blocks.zh_text: 拼命想出一个能拿下百万经费的绝妙点子。

blocks.en_text: But I realized that the grant-writing was going well,
blocks.zh_text: 但我意识到，经费申请确实写得顺利，

blocks.en_text: because I was able to focus and maintain my attention
blocks.zh_text: 因为我能专注并保持注意力，

blocks.en_text: for longer than I had before.
blocks.zh_text: 时间比我以前更长了。

blocks.en_text: And my long-term memory -- what I was studying in my own lab --
blocks.zh_text: 还有我的长期记忆——也就是我自己实验室研究的东西——

blocks.en_text: seemed to be better in me.
blocks.zh_text: 在我身上似乎也变好了。

blocks.en_text: And that's when I put it together.
blocks.zh_text: 就在那时，我把这些联系到了一起。

blocks.en_text: Maybe all that exercise that I had included and added to my life
blocks.zh_text: 也许我纳入生活、增加的那些锻炼，

blocks.en_text: was changing my brain.
blocks.zh_text: 正在改变我的大脑。

blocks.en_text: Maybe I did an experiment on myself without even knowing it.
blocks.zh_text: 也许我在不知不觉中对自己做了一场实验。

blocks.en_text: So as a curious neuroscientist,
blocks.zh_text: 于是，作为一个充满好奇的神经科学家，

blocks.en_text: I went to the literature to see what I could find about what we knew
blocks.zh_text: 我去查阅文献，看看关于我们所了解的

blocks.en_text: about the effects of exercise on the brain.
blocks.zh_text: 运动对大脑的影响，能找到些什么。

blocks.en_text: And what I found was an exciting and a growing literature
blocks.zh_text: 结果我发现，文献令人兴奋，而且越来越多，

blocks.en_text: that was essentially showing everything that I noticed in myself.
blocks.zh_text: 基本上印证了我在自己身上注意到的一切。

blocks.en_text: Better mood, better energy, better memory, better attention.
blocks.zh_text: 心情更好，精力更足，记忆更好，注意力更集中。

blocks.en_text: And the more I learned,
blocks.zh_text: 我了解得越多，

blocks.en_text: the more I realized how powerful exercise was.
blocks.zh_text: 就越意识到运动有多么强大。

blocks.en_text: Which eventually led me to the big decision
blocks.zh_text: 这最终让我做出了一个重大决定，

blocks.en_text: to completely shift my research focus.
blocks.zh_text: 彻底转变我的研究方向。

blocks.en_text: And so now, after several years of really focusing on this question,
blocks.zh_text: 所以现在，在真正专注研究这个问题几年之后，

blocks.en_text: I've come to the following conclusion:
blocks.zh_text: 我得出了以下结论：

blocks.en_text: that exercise is the most transformative thing
blocks.zh_text: 运动是最能改变你的事物，

blocks.en_text: that you can do for your brain today
blocks.zh_text: 是今天你能为自己的大脑做的最有变革性的事，

blocks.en_text: for the following three reasons.
blocks.zh_text: 原因有以下三点。

blocks.en_text: Number one: it has immediate effects on your brain.
blocks.zh_text: 第一：它对大脑有立竿见影的效果。

blocks.en_text: A single workout that you do
blocks.zh_text: 你只要做一次锻炼，

blocks.en_text: will immediately increase levels of neurotransmitters
blocks.zh_text: 就会立刻提高神经递质的水平，

blocks.en_text: like dopamine, serotonin and noradrenaline.
blocks.zh_text: 比如多巴胺、血清素和去甲肾上腺素。

blocks.en_text: That is going to increase your mood right after that workout,
blocks.zh_text: 这会让你在锻炼之后马上心情变好，

blocks.en_text: exactly what I was feeling.
blocks.zh_text: 正是我当时感受到的那样。

blocks.en_text: My lab showed that a single workout
blocks.zh_text: 我的实验室表明，一次锻炼

blocks.en_text: can improve your ability to shift and focus attention,
blocks.zh_text: 就能提升你转移和集中注意力的能力，

blocks.en_text: and that focus improvement will last for at least two hours.
blocks.zh_text: 而且这种注意力的改善至少会持续两个小时。

blocks.en_text: And finally, studies have shown
blocks.zh_text: 最后，研究显示

blocks.en_text: that a single workout will improve your reaction times
blocks.zh_text: 一次锻炼就能改善你的反应时间，

blocks.en_text: which basically means
blocks.zh_text: 这基本上意味着

blocks.en_text: that you are going to be faster at catching that cup of Starbucks
blocks.zh_text: 你能更快地接住那杯星巴克

blocks.en_text: that falls off the counter,
blocks.zh_text: 从台面上掉下来的咖啡，

blocks.en_text: which is very, very important.
blocks.zh_text: 这一点非常非常重要。

blocks.en_text: But these immediate effects are transient, they help you right after.
blocks.zh_text: 但这些即时效果是短暂的，它们只在运动后马上帮到你。

blocks.en_text: What you have to do is do what I did,
blocks.zh_text: 你要做的是像我那样做，

blocks.en_text: that is change your exercise regime, increase your cardiorespiratory function,
blocks.zh_text: 也就是改变你的运动方式，提高你的心肺功能，

blocks.en_text: to get the long-lasting effects.
blocks.zh_text: 才能获得持久的效果。

blocks.en_text: And these effects are long-lasting
blocks.zh_text: 而这些效果是持久的，

blocks.en_text: because exercise actually changes the brain's anatomy,
blocks.zh_text: 因为运动实际上会改变大脑的解剖结构、

blocks.en_text: physiology and function.
blocks.zh_text: 生理机能和功能。

blocks.en_text: Let's start with my favorite brain area, the hippocampus.
blocks.zh_text: 我们先从我特别喜欢的大脑区域——海马体说起。

blocks.en_text: The hippocampus --
blocks.zh_text: 海马体——

blocks.en_text: or exercise actually produces brand new brain cells,
blocks.zh_text: 或者说，运动实际上会产生全新的脑细胞，

blocks.en_text: new brain cells in the hippocampus, that actually increase its volume,
blocks.zh_text: 海马体里新的脑细胞，它们实际上会增大海马体的体积，

blocks.en_text: as well as improve your long-term memory, OK?
blocks.zh_text: 同时改善你的长期记忆，好吗？

blocks.en_text: And that including in you and me.
blocks.zh_text: 而且这对你和我都适用。

blocks.en_text: Number two: the most common finding in neuroscience studies,
blocks.zh_text: 第二点：神经科学研究中最常见的发现，

blocks.en_text: looking at effects of long-term exercise,
blocks.zh_text: 在考察长期运动的效果时，

blocks.en_text: is improved attention function dependent on your prefrontal cortex.
blocks.zh_text: 就是依赖于前额叶皮层的注意力功能得到改善。

blocks.en_text: You not only get better focus and attention,
blocks.zh_text: 你不仅专注力和注意力变得更好，

blocks.en_text: but the volume of the hippocampus increases as well.
blocks.zh_text: 海马体的体积也会增大。

blocks.en_text: And finally, you not only get immediate effects of mood with exercise
blocks.zh_text: 最后，运动不仅会立刻改善你的情绪，

blocks.en_text: but those last for a long time.
blocks.zh_text: 而且这些效果会持续很长时间。

blocks.en_text: So you get long-lasting increases in those good mood neurotransmitters.
blocks.zh_text: 所以那些让人心情好的神经递质会持久地增加。

blocks.en_text: But really, the most transformative thing that exercise will do
blocks.zh_text: 但真正来说，运动最具变革性的作用

blocks.en_text: is its protective effects on your brain.
blocks.zh_text: 是它对大脑的保护作用。

blocks.en_text: Here you can think about the brain like a muscle.
blocks.zh_text: 在这里，你可以把大脑想象成一块肌肉。

blocks.en_text: The more you're working out,
blocks.zh_text: 你锻炼得越多，

blocks.en_text: the bigger and stronger your hippocampus and prefrontal cortex gets.
blocks.zh_text: 你的海马体和前额叶皮层就越大、越强壮。

blocks.en_text: Why is that important?
blocks.zh_text: 这为什么重要呢？

blocks.en_text: Because the prefrontal cortex and the hippocampus
blocks.zh_text: 因为前额叶皮层和海马体

blocks.en_text: are the two areas that are most susceptible to neurodegenerative diseases
blocks.zh_text: 是最容易受到神经退行性疾病影响的

blocks.en_text: and normal cognitive decline in aging.
blocks.zh_text: 以及衰老过程中正常认知衰退的两个区域。

blocks.en_text: So with increased exercise over your lifetime,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，如果你在一生中增加运动量，

blocks.en_text: you're not going to cure dementia or Alzheimer's disease,
blocks.zh_text: 你并不能治愈痴呆症或阿尔茨海默病，

blocks.en_text: but what you're going to do is you're going to create
blocks.zh_text: 但你能做的是，

blocks.en_text: the strongest, biggest hippocampus and prefrontal cortex
blocks.zh_text: 打造出最强壮、最大的海马体和前额叶皮层，

blocks.en_text: so it takes longer for these diseases to actually have an effect.
blocks.zh_text: 这样这些疾病要真正产生影响就需要更长时间。

blocks.en_text: You can think of exercise, therefore,
blocks.zh_text: 因此，你可以把运动想象成

blocks.en_text: as a supercharged 401K for your brain, OK?
blocks.zh_text: 为你大脑开设的一个超级充值的401K退休账户，好吗？

blocks.en_text: And it's even better, because it's free.
blocks.zh_text: 而且它甚至更好，因为它是免费的。

blocks.en_text: So this is the point in the talk where everybody says,
blocks.zh_text: 所以，讲到这里，每个人都会说：

blocks.en_text: "That sounds so interesting, Wendy,
blocks.zh_text: “温迪，这听起来太有意思了，

blocks.en_text: but I really will only want to know one thing.
blocks.zh_text: 但我真正只想知道一件事。

blocks.en_text: And that is, just tell me the minimum amount of exercise
blocks.zh_text: 那就是，直接告诉我最少的运动量

blocks.en_text: I need to get all these changes."
blocks.zh_text: 我需要多少才能获得所有这些改变。”

blocks.en_text: And so I'm going to tell you the answer to that question.
blocks.zh_text: 那我就来告诉你这个问题的答案。

blocks.en_text: First, good news: you don't have to become a triathlete to get these effects.
blocks.zh_text: 首先，好消息：你不必成为铁人三项运动员就能获得这些效果。

blocks.en_text: The rule of thumb is you want to get three to four times a week exercise
blocks.zh_text: 经验法则是，你每周要锻炼三到四次

blocks.en_text: minimum 30 minutes an exercise session,
blocks.zh_text: 每次至少30分钟，

blocks.en_text: and you want to get aerobic exercise in.
blocks.zh_text: 而且你要做有氧运动。

blocks.en_text: That is, get your heart rate up.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是说，让心率升上去。

blocks.en_text: And the good news is, you don't have to go to the gym
blocks.zh_text: 好消息是，你不必去健身房

blocks.en_text: to get a very expensive gym membership.
blocks.zh_text: 也不必办一张很贵的健身房会员卡。

blocks.en_text: Add an extra walk around the block in your power walk.
blocks.zh_text: 在你快走锻炼时，多绕街区走一圈。

blocks.en_text: You see stairs -- take stairs.
blocks.zh_text: 看到楼梯——就走楼梯。

blocks.en_text: And power-vacuuming can be as good as the aerobics class
blocks.zh_text: 而且用力地吸尘打扫，效果可以和健美操课一样好

blocks.en_text: that you were going to take at the gym.
blocks.zh_text: 就像你原本打算在健身房上的那种课。

blocks.en_text: So I've gone from memory pioneer
blocks.zh_text: 所以我从记忆研究的先驱

blocks.en_text: to exercise explorer.
blocks.zh_text: 变成了运动的探索者。

blocks.en_text: From going into the innermost workings of the brain,
blocks.zh_text: 从深入大脑最内部的运作机制，

blocks.en_text: to trying to understand how exercise can improve our brain function,
blocks.zh_text: 到试图理解运动如何改善我们的大脑功能，

blocks.en_text: and my goal in my lab right now
blocks.zh_text: 而我现在在实验室里的目标

blocks.en_text: is to go beyond that rule of thumb that I just gave you --
blocks.zh_text: 就是超越我刚才给你的那条经验法则——

blocks.en_text: three to four times a week, 30 minutes.
blocks.zh_text: 每周三到四次，每次30分钟。

blocks.en_text: I want to understand the optimum exercise prescription
blocks.zh_text: 我想弄清楚最佳的运动处方

blocks.en_text: for you, at your age, at your fitness level,
blocks.zh_text: 针对你、针对你的年龄、针对你的体能水平，

blocks.en_text: for your genetic background,
blocks.zh_text: 针对你的遗传背景，

blocks.en_text: to maximize the effects of exercise today
blocks.zh_text: 从而最大化今天的运动效果

blocks.en_text: and also to improve your brain and protect your brain the best
blocks.zh_text: 同时最好地改善你的大脑、保护你的大脑

blocks.en_text: for the rest of your life.
blocks.zh_text: 让你受用余生。

blocks.en_text: But it's one thing to talk about exercise, and it's another to do it.
blocks.zh_text: 但谈论运动是一回事，真正去做又是另一回事。

blocks.en_text: So I'm going to invoke my power as a certified exercise instructor,
blocks.zh_text: 所以我要动用我作为持证运动教练的力量，

blocks.en_text: to ask you all to stand up.
blocks.zh_text: 请大家都站起来。

blocks.en_text: We're going to do just one minute of exercise.
blocks.zh_text: 我们就做一分钟的运动。

blocks.en_text: It's call-and-response, just do what I do, say what I say,
blocks.zh_text: 这是一喊一应，跟着我做，跟着我说，

blocks.en_text: and make sure you don't punch your neighbor, OK?
blocks.zh_text: 注意别打到旁边的人，好吗？

blocks.en_text: Music!
blocks.zh_text: 音乐！

blocks.en_text: (Upbeat music)
blocks.zh_text: （欢快的音乐）

blocks.en_text: Five, six, seven, eight, it's right, left, right, left.
blocks.zh_text: 五、六、七、八，右、左、右、左。

blocks.en_text: And I say, I am strong now.
blocks.zh_text: 然后我说，我现在很强壮。

blocks.en_text: Let's hear you.
blocks.zh_text: 让我听听你们说。

blocks.en_text: Audience: I am strong now.
blocks.zh_text: 观众：我现在很强壮。

blocks.en_text: Wendy Suzuki: Ladies, I am Wonder Woman-strong.
blocks.zh_text: Wendy Suzuki：女士们，我像神奇女侠一样强壮。

blocks.en_text: Let's hear you!
blocks.zh_text: 让我听听你们说！

blocks.en_text: Audience: I am Wonder Woman-strong.
blocks.zh_text: 观众：我像神奇女侠一样强壮。

blocks.en_text: WS: New move -- uppercut, right and left.
blocks.zh_text: WS：新动作——上勾拳，右和左。

blocks.en_text: I am inspired now. You say it!
blocks.zh_text: 我现在充满灵感。你们说！

blocks.en_text: Audience: I am inspired now.
blocks.zh_text: 观众：我现在充满灵感。

blocks.en_text: WS: Last move -- pull it down, right and left, right and left.
blocks.zh_text: WS：最后一个动作——往下拉，右和左，右和左。

blocks.en_text: I say, I am on fire now! You say it.
blocks.zh_text: 我说，我现在火力全开！你们说。

blocks.en_text: Audience: I am on fire now.
blocks.zh_text: 观众：我现在火力全开。

blocks.en_text: WS: And done! OK, good job!
blocks.zh_text: WS：完成！好，干得好！

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢。

blocks.en_text: I want to leave you with one last thought.
blocks.zh_text: 我想留给你们最后一个想法。

blocks.en_text: And that is, bringing exercise in your life
blocks.zh_text: 那就是，把运动带进你的生活

blocks.en_text: will not only give you a happier, more protective life today,
blocks.zh_text: 不仅会让你今天过得更快乐、更有保障，

blocks.en_text: but it will protect your brain from incurable diseases.
blocks.zh_text: 还能保护你的大脑免受无法治愈的疾病侵害。

blocks.en_text: And in this way it will change the trajectory of your life
blocks.zh_text: 这样一来，它就会改变你的人生轨迹，

blocks.en_text: for the better.
blocks.zh_text: 让它变得更好。

blocks.en_text: Thank you very much.
blocks.zh_text: 非常感谢。

blocks.en_text: Thank you.
blocks.zh_text: 谢谢。
